title: Analytic convexity bounds and high-precision zero surfaces
question: Can explicit sufficient Legendre and thermodynamic bounds protect the entire discovery box, and how are the production, condition-number, thermodynamic-zero, and Legendre-zero amplitudes ordered on the central state?
prediction: Both analytic lower bounds remain positive at the production cap; both guaranteed amplitudes exceed 0.17; the central denial surfaces occur in the order production cap, condition-number gate, thermodynamic determinant zero, and Legendre determinant zero; binary64 roots agree with 80-digit results below 1e-14.
falsifier: A sufficient lower bound is nonpositive, a guaranteed amplitude does not exceed the production cap, the denial ordering changes, or either root comparison exceeds tolerance.
controls: The inequalities use monotonic endpoint bounds and Gershgorin lower estimates, not fitted sampled minima.
Nonnegative counterflow contributions to the Legendre diagonals are deliberately discarded, making the result sufficient rather than optimistic.
The thermodynamic and Legendre determinant zeros are solved independently with 80-digit bisection.
Binary64 formulas use a separate algebraic evaluation and bisection path.
The condition-number amplitude is imported as a fixed observed boundary from the accepted NUL-CHR-005 record and is not refitted.
seed_rationale: The derivation and high-precision root solves are deterministic.
